title: 85 individuals processed at Broward facilities on June 6
text:
On June 6, 2026, booking data shows that 85 individuals were processed at Broward, FL facilities.
The ‘Other’ charge category was listed in 36 entries, followed by ‘Domestic’ with 21 and ‘Warrant’ with 19. Both ‘Property’ and ‘Drug’ categories appeared in 15 entries each. The most frequently cited charges were “TOUCH OR STRIKE/BATTERY/DOMESTIC VIOL” in 13 cases and “RESIST OFFICER-OBSTRUCT WITHOUT VIOLENCE” in nine cases, respectively.
Charges reflected in booking records are those listed at the time of processing. The listed individuals have not been found guilty of any charge based on this record.
